title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Protection of the Rights of Consumers of Commercial Housing

articles.content_en: 1. The priority ranking among the construction project price priority right of compensation, mortgage, and other claims shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 36 of the Interpretation (I) of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts.

2. Where a commodity housing consumer purchases a house for the purpose of residence and has paid the full price, and claims that his right to demand delivery of the house has priority over the construction project price priority right of compensation, mortgage, and other claims, the People's Court shall support such claim.
Where a commodity housing consumer who has only paid part of the price has actually paid the remaining price before the conclusion of the court debate at first instance, the preceding paragraph may apply.

3. In the case where the house cannot be delivered and there is no actual possibility of delivery, where a commodity housing consumer claims that his right to demand refund of the price has priority over the construction project price priority right of compensation, mortgage, and other claims, the People's Court shall support such claim.
